name: Data.Pair.trivialLift_apply
summary: Unfold the lift as a class sum of kernel forms, write Υ as the sum over A of translates of the level-indicator datum, and collect.

steps.claim: Evaluate the algebraic form trivialLift(H, ϑ) at h: it is the scalar times the class sum of the kernel forms (`map_classSum`); the classes of U(1) at the chosen level are the classes with trivial automorphism groups (`Data.classAut_eq_bot_of_le_chosenLevel`); the jets of the jet series are scalar multiples (`schurJet_jetSeries_eq_smul`); and Υ = ∑_A of the translates of the level-indicator datum (`AuxPair.upsilon_eq_sum`); reorganizing the double sum over (u, A) gives the formula.
steps.lean:
h := by erw [apply_eq_evalForm, map_smul, map_classSum, classSum,
  funext (D.classAut_eq_bot_of_le_chosenLevel
  le_rfl (by simpa using D.nat_le_of_hasLogBound))]; simp [smul_sum, kernelValue, pointDatum,
  schurJet_jetSeries_eq_smul (isLiftWeight _) (_ * _), sum_prod_type, smul_smul, rep_apply_apply,
  kernelForm, Matrix.sum_mulVec, boxes, AuxPair.upsilon_eq_sum,
  ↓← apply_eq_evalForm]; simp [AuxPair.κ, mixedWeight, (lValueData H ϑ).one_lt_card]; rfl
